_doc: Body-space definitions of the 21 canonical Auramaxxing muscle regions.
The anatomy SVGs remain the SEMANTIC authority for what each region means;
these rules are how that region is REPRESENTED on the actual 3D body.
Coordinates are landmark-relative, never a single global affine:
t      fraction between two named landmarks (0 = first, 1 = second)
side   front | back | any        - from the surface normal, not position
lat    [lo,hi] fraction of the torso half-width at that height
part   torso | arm_upper | arm_lower | leg_upper | leg_lower | shoulder
confidence: HIGH   boundary sits on a real measured landmark
MEDIUM boundary is a proportional subdivision between landmarks
LOW    boundary is a convention with no distinct landmark

nipple.from: mean z of MPFB nipple group

waist.from: z of minimum torso width between nipple and crotch

crotch.from: lowest z where the legs are still joined

knee.from: z of minimum leg width between crotch and ankle

ankle.from: min z of body + 4% of leg length

elbow.from: midpoint of shoulder->wrist along the arm axis

wrist.from: far end of the arm axis

regions.name: Upper Chest
regions.note: clavicular pec head, above the nipple line

regions.name: Middle Chest
regions.note: sternal pec at the nipple line

regions.name: Lower Chest
regions.note: costal pec, nipple line to pec insertion

regions.name: Front Shoulders
regions.note: anterior deltoid

regions.name: Lateral Shoulders
regions.note: lateral deltoid, outermost shoulder surface

regions.name: Rear Shoulders
regions.note: posterior deltoid

regions.name: Traps
regions.note: upper trapezius, neck base to mid-scapula, inboard

regions.name: Lats
regions.note: latissimus sweep, outboard of the spine

regions.name: Upper Back
regions.note: rhomboid / mid-trap field between the scapulae

regions.name: Lower Back
regions.note: erector spinae, waist to pelvis

regions.name: Biceps
regions.note: anterior upper arm below the deltoid

regions.name: Triceps
regions.note: posterior upper arm below the deltoid

regions.name: Forearms
regions.note: everything distal to the elbow

regions.name: Upper Abs
regions.note: upper rectus, below the pec insertion

regions.name: Middle Abs
regions.note: mid rectus at the navel

regions.name: Lower Abs
regions.note: lower rectus, navel to pelvis

regions.name: Obliques
regions.note: external oblique flank, outboard of the rectus

regions.name: Glutes
regions.note: gluteal mass on the pelvis; belongs to the torso, not the thigh

regions.name: Hamstrings
regions.note: posterior thigh below the glute fold

regions.name: Quads
regions.note: anterior thigh

regions.name: Calves
regions.note: whole lower leg; the 21-region taxonomy has no tibialis, so the anterior shin is folded into Calves rather than left unassigned

Lower Abs: The female anatomy SVG ships an EMPTY Lower Abs group, so the 2D muscle
map cannot highlight it. The 3D region is still defined here because the
SVG is the semantic authority, not the geometric source: the region is
anatomically real on the female body and is derived from the female
body's own landmarks. No male geometry is copied.
The 2D map remains unsupported until that SVG group is authored.
chest: Female chest bands are measured from the female body's own nipple
landmark, which sits lower relative to the shoulder than on the male
body, so the bands are not a scaled copy of the male rules.
